items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: But he was plugging, like, Monica Lewis and Monica Boyer, and you know, a gang of singers out there...

ctx.x: Well, I'd get mad. You know, I'd want to fight. I ain't lettin' them tell me... And the agents and everything, they'll owe you money, and they have to hold it. So I just couldn't put up with that.

That's who came in (?) night. Martin Block. He had the biggest show on radio. When I approached him in the (?) and asked him, "Have you heard my wife?" He said, "Yes, I have." I said, "Will you give our records a plug?" He said, "Yes, I'll plug them sometimes," just like that. I expected him to say something, "Oh yeah..." But he was so cool, the way he was... But he was plugging, like, Monica Lewis and Monica Boyer, and you know, a gang of singers out there... But he was looking right at her, and he (?)ain't…
